sloka: मूलम् मूलवता स्प्Rष्टम् धूप्यते धूम केतुना ।नैरृतम् नैरृतानाम् च नक्षत्रम् अभिपीड्यते ॥६-४-५२॥।।
transliteration: mūlam mūlavatā spRṣṭam dhūpyate dhūma ketunā ।nairṛtam nairṛtānām ca nakṣatram abhipīḍyate ॥6-4-52॥।।

translations.english: The star called Niruta (of rakshasas) in the southwest is highly tormented by the touch of the Mula star (close to it) and is oppressed.
